newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya tea prices firmer on strong demand.
newsitem.headline: Kenya tea prices firmer on strong demand.

text.p: Tea prices were firmer overall on strong demand at the weekly Kenya tea auction in Mombasa on Monday, auction officials said.

Brighter and medium BP1s were fully firm by five U.S. cents while lower mediums were steady. PF1s of all descriptions were fully firm but brighter PDUSTs were irregular. Selected lines of DUST 1s were irregularly dearer.
Brighter well sorted Fannings and Dusts were fully firm while more fibrous descriptions were discounted.
Pakistan was active. There was strong demand from Egypt and the Sudan, while enquiry from Britain was selective.
